             BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

             IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                      )
             OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY                        ) Case No. PUD2026-000031
             FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL OF ELECTRIC                      )
             SERVICE AGREEMENTS AND PREAPPROVAL                       )
             OF CAPACITY PURCHASE AGREEMENTS                          )
             PURSUANT 17 O.S. § 286(C)                                )

                  THE PUBLIC UTILITY DIVISION’S WITNESS AND EXHIBIT LIST

                   COMES NOW the Public Utility Division of the Oklahoma Corporation Commission
            (“PUD”), by and through the undersigned counsel, and hereby submits the following list of
            witnesses and exhibits that PUD may present or rely upon during the hearing on the merits in
            this Case:

                   Witnesses

                   1. Frank Mossburg
                   2. David Scalf

                   Exhibits

                   1. All documents filed of record in this Case prior to the hearing on the merits;
                   2. All testimony and exhibits, schedules, and work papers filed, or exchanged, in this
                       Case;
                   3. All documents exchanged between the parties including, but not limited to all data
                       requests and responses thereto, and e-mails;
                   4. All documents entered into the record at the hearing on the merits, including but
                       not limited to, any settlement stipulation and all exhibits attached thereto;
                   5. All statutes, rules, cases, and regulatory decisions addressing any legal issue
                       arising in this proceeding;
                   6. All documents necessary or helpful for examination of witnesses in this Case;
                   7. All items included in the exhibit list of any other party to this Case, unless
                       otherwise objected to by PUD;
                   8. Any other exhibits agreed to by the parties and approved by the Administrative
                       Law Judge.

                   PUD reserves the right to supplement this Witness and Exhibit List.
